notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, chrome impersonation) returned a 9.9KB client-rendered SPA shell for homepage and every category slug tried (identical bytes regardless of path) - no usable nav/counts. robots.txt is fully open (Disallow: none), no bot restrictions at any tier. Escalated to tier (b) Playwright headless chromium: rendered pages fine (300KB+ DOM). Nav submenu hover required el.dispatch_event('mouseover') instead of Locator.hover() because a Klaviyo popup/newsletter overlay intercepted pointer events and made real hover() time out. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome not needed. TREE: built from union of (1) mega-menu top nav (New/Furniture/Decor/Window/Bedding/Outdoor/Fabric/Inspiration/Free Swatches/Trade), each hovered to reveal its submenu, and (2) sitemap.xml sitemap-index (product-type sitemaps: accent-tables, beds, chairs, fabric-by-the-yard, gift-wrap, indoor-rugs, lighting, mattresses, notebooks, outdoor-pillows, outdoor-rugs, room-dividers, sofas-sectionals, throw-blankets, throw-pillow-covers, throw-pillows, wallpaper, swatches, etc - used to sanity-check nothing was missed, not as a qty source since it enumerates per-size/color product-variant URLs rather than the category-page product count). QTY: the site exposes no explicit 'N products' text, no pagination total, and no JSON count field in any script tag or XHR/fetch response captured during page load (checked network responses and inline script content on all target pages - none found). Used the storage-rules fallback method (paginate/scroll and count unique product cards): scrolled each category page with mouse-wheel to exhaustion (stopped after 2+ consecutive rounds with no new /products/ links), counted unique product-detail links surfaced as cards. Cross-checked: Throw Blankets rendered count (9) exactly matches sitemap-throw-blankets.xml url count (9), and Fabric By the Yard was stable at 10 across 19 repeated scroll rounds - both give confidence in the method. Every recorded leaf's h1/title was verified to match the requested node (h1=None + generic homepage title = invalid/guessed slug, discarded). EXCLUDED and why: entire Furniture submenu (Beds, Headboards, Benches, Mattresses, Nightstands, Sofas, Accent Chairs, Ottomans, Coffee Tables, Dining Chairs, Bar Stools, Cabana Chairs) - furniture, not textile/storage; Lighting - out of scope category; Wallpaper ('On a Roll' - peel-and-stick paper/vinyl wall covering, not a fabric product per textile.md SS14); Free Swatches / Inspiration / Trade / New Arrivals - service/editorial/promotional pages, not product categories; Best Selling Curtains - sales-rank curation cutting across the Curtains catalog, promotional per textile.md SS27; Cafe Curtains nav link points to a single product-detail URL, not a listing page - excluded per URL rule; Pickleball Paddles (Outdoor submenu) - sporting good, not textile; guessed Bedding sub-slugs (collections/duvet-covers, sheet-sets, shams, pillowcases, all mirroring the Bedding nav's product-detail links) all resolved to h1=None with the generic site-wide fallback title, proving they are not real category pages - so Bedding is recorded as one leaf (All Bedding, h1 'Organic Cotton Bedding'). Floral/Animal Print/Striped/Velvet Curtains ARE genuine distinct nav-linked listing pages (own h1, own product set, larger qty than 'All Curtains' alone) so all five Window entries are recorded as siblings, matching the mega-menu's own flat nesting - this is a judgment call worth a human glance if reconciling against 'All Curtains' totals. STORAGE: no Storage/Organization category, submenu, footer link, or sitemap product-type (boxes/baskets/organizers/bins/racks/shelving/hampers/closet) exists anywhere on this site - The Inside sells only made-to-order upholstered furniture, fabric home-textiles, wallpaper, and fabric-by-the-yard/swatches. storage_rows is empty by design (NO_CATEGORY), not a block.
